name: Notion Airlock
description: Let an AI operator search, read, create, and update Notion pages and databases without betting your workspace on it. An agent that can touch Notion unattended is one bad inference away from archiving the wrong page or polluting a database — which is why most teams keep every create and update by hand. Notion Airlock gives the agent eight real Notion commands and removes the unattended trigger: reads run freely, while every page creation, database creation, block append, and archive stops at a human approval bound to the exact payload, executes once, and leaves an Ed25519-signed receipt. Approval is bound to the payload hash, so an edited payload has no approval and cannot run. Optimistic preconditions refuse stale approvals when the live page state moved since you approved. Pure domain planners are isolated from vault and I/O; a fixed-origin transport is the only network layer. Every successful result carries a deterministic SHA-256 event chain from intent through live observation and decision to verified outcome. The API token is read from RailCall's vault, never accepted as input, never logged, never returned, and Notion's own errors are surfaced instead of a fabricated success. contest:2026Q3.
